RecipeDef.label: install servitor mining arm
RecipeDef.description: Installs an augmetic replacement arm designed for mining servitors. The arm is composed of industrial micro-las emitters, several drill bits, scoops, and filters to sieve rare minerals from less valuable rock.

RecipeDef.label: install servitor agri-arm
RecipeDef.description: Installs an augmetic replacement arm designed for agricultural servitors. The servitor agri-arm has a built in seed planter and fertilizer spreader to make farming easier. The fingers are replaced with multiple mechascythes that greatly speed up gathering work, but destroy a small amount of the harvest.

RecipeDef.label: install servitor industrial arm
RecipeDef.description: Installs an augmetic replacement arm designed for manufactorum and construction servitors. The industrial version of the servitor arm has a clamp, a built in fusion welder and robust secondary manipulators to allow for better construction and crafting.

RecipeDef.label: install servitor multi-melta-arm
RecipeDef.description: Replaces the existing limb with a weapon attachment. The servitor melta-arm consists of a large melta gun for combat but greatly impairs any functions other than combat
